    name: str
    email: str | None
    task: str
    deadline: str

class TodoListExtraction(BaseModel):
    tasks: List[TaskAssignment]

file_content = files[0].content

    "Extract all TODO items from the following meeting minutes file. For each TODO, provide the assignee's name, their email if available, the task description, and the deadline in YYYY-MM-DD format. If the email is not present, just provide the name.",

)

    else:
        contacts = search_contacts_by_name(task.name)
        if len(contacts) == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"No contact found for {task.name}.")
        # Disambiguate if multiple contacts
        if len(contacts) > 1:
            contact = query_ai_assistant(
                f"Given the following contacts: {contacts}, select the one that matches the assignee '{task.name}' for the task: '{task.task}' with deadline {task.deadline}.",
                EmailContact
            )
        else:
            contact = contacts[0]
        tasks_with_emails = [*tasks_with_emails, TaskAssignment(name=task.name, email=contact.email, task=task.task, deadline=task.deadline)]

# Step 4: Send an email to each person with their task and deadline
for task in tasks_with_emails:
    subject = f"Action Required: Task Assignment from Team Meeting"
    body = (
        f"Dear {task.name},\n\n"
        f"You have been assigned the following task from the recent team meeting:\n\n"
        f"Task: {task.task}\n"
        f"Deadline: {task.deadline}\n\n"
        f"Please ensure this task is completed by the specified deadline. If you have any questions, let me know.\n\n"
        f"Best regards,\nEmma Johnson\nBlue Sparrow Tech"
